name: Economics and Business Administration (Herning)
summary: The same subject as the Aarhus programme — how companies create value, attract customers and decide — taught on AU's small Herning campus in West Jutland, with a practical bent towards how businesses actually operate. Much lower cut-off than Aarhus, and a smaller, more personal setting; the trade-off is a town of about fifty thousand rather than Denmark's second city.

family.name: Economics and Business Administration
family.differs: A small campus in West Jutland that works with real companies from day one; the same degree, a much lower cut-off.
